sections.ItemName:
Large Shield
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Large Shield
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Short Sword
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Short Sword
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Short Sword
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Bastard Sword
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Bastard Sword
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Bastard Sword
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.

have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went

pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Ancient Armor
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Ancient Armor
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Ancient Armor
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Cap
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Perfect Ruby
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Perfect Ruby
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Perfect Ruby
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Ral Rune
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Ral Rune
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Ral Rune
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Ral Rune
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Tome of Town Portal
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc4Horadric Cube
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
ÿc4Horadric Cube
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc4Horadric Cube
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Preserved Head
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.
